name: 3D figure scene, bottom-left text stack
description: A full-screen canvas scene, 100svh, on one flat dark stage (the page ground on a dark page, the ink field on a light one): one central figure or sculpture (a character, a product model) about 55-65% of the screen height, centred slightly right of the middle. At bottom-left, at the page margin and 56px from the bottom: the headline at the display step in two lines at most, in one face, each line whole; above it a one-line sub at the lead step (max 280px wide); under it the dealt button. The dealt navigation sits on top. Pinned for 150vh: scroll orbits the camera 30-60 degrees and shifts the scene between two flat tones (the ground and the surface tone) while the text stays. Colour roles: the dark stage, type in the lighter of the ground and the ink; accent = the scene's key light and the button.
signature: One 3D figure, 55-65% of the screen height and slightly right of centre, stands on a flat dark stage while the two-line headline holds bottom-left; scrolling orbits the camera 30-60 degrees over 150vh and the text does not move.
phone: The figure at 55% of the height in the upper part; the headline at the display step in two lines at the bottom, the sub under it, then the dealt button; the camera orbit runs over 120vh of scroll.
houseRuleCheck: One face per line, never a picked-out word. Needs a real 3D model or a looping render of the figure: no drawn stand-in. The pin holds 150vh at most. The accent is the key light and the button only.

name: Bottom portrait row under the headline
description: One screen, 100svh, on the dealt ground, the dealt navigation on top on the same 12-column grid as the tiles. The upper part holds the headline at the display step in two lines on the first columns and, at the right end of the same row, the dealt button. Anchored to the bottom, 24px above the edge and inside the page margins, a row of five picture tiles (4:5, the dealt corner, 8px gaps, about 255px wide at 1440), each with a one-line caption at the body step (a name or a title) directly under it. The headline, button and tiles arrive with the dealt entrance. Hover: the hovered tile widens (flex-grow 1 to 1.7) while the others narrow, its picture scales 1.05 and its caption takes the accent. Colour roles: the dealt ground and ink; accent = the hover caption and the button.
signature: A row of five 4:5 picture tiles with captions runs along the bottom of the first screen, 24px above the edge, and hovering one widens it (flex-grow 1 to 1.7) while the others narrow.
phone: The headline at the display step top-left in two lines at most; the dealt button full width under it; below it a 2x2 grid of four tiles (the fifth dropped) with 8px gaps and a caption under each; no hover widening.
houseRuleCheck: A fixed row of five that fits the width, never an endless, dragged or auto-moving row; captions at the body step in sentence case; the page margin to every edge. Pictures are styled fashion, lifestyle or product shots, never documentary. The upper part is held by the headline and button, never a blank stretch.

name: Central object, content in four quadrants
description: One 100svh stage on a flat colour surface (the dealt ground) or a top-down photograph of a real tabletop, the dealt navigation on top. One object, a product cut-out (a transparent webp), dead centre at about 30% of the screen height. Content sits in the quadrants around it, all at the page margin from the edges: top-left the headline at the display step in two lines; right of centre one sentence at the lead step (max 320px wide); bottom-left one short line at the body step; bottom-right the dealt button. All of it is plain text and the one button; no card or tile over the scene; five text items at most. On scroll the object scales to 1.12 (a 3D model, if the page has one, turns 90 degrees instead) while the items drift 12px in opposing directions. Colour roles: ground = the surface; ink contrasting; accent = the button.
signature: One object about 30% of the screen height sits dead centre and a text item sits in each of the four quadrants at the page margin: the headline top-left, one sentence right of centre, one line bottom-left, the dealt button bottom-right.
phone: The object top-centre at 40% of the height; the headline above it; the sentence and the short line stacked below it in two rows; the dealt button full width at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: No translucent card, video tile, edge tab or bar over the scene; running text 16px or more; everything at the page margin; five text items at most.

name: Small 3D object over sentence and pill
description: The dealt ground, 100svh, the dealt navigation on top. One small 3D object (thin rings, a bottle, a knot; about 320px wide; a model or transparent renders) rests just above the middle, turns slowly and tilts toward the pointer. Under it, centred, the headline at the display step in two lines (max 900px wide), and 28px under that the dealt button. One text link at the body step bottom-left. Nothing else. The headline and button arrive with the dealt entrance; the object is there in the first frame. On scroll the object scales to 1.6 while the headline fades. Colour roles: the dealt ground and ink, accent = the object's one hue and the button.
signature: A small 3D object about 320px wide turns slowly above the middle of the dealt ground and tilts toward the pointer, with the headline and the dealt button centred under it and nothing else.
phone: The object 60% of the width above the centre; the headline at the display step in two lines at most; the dealt button full width; the text link under it.
houseRuleCheck: One hue for the object and the button. Needs a real 3D model or transparent renders of the object: no drawn stand-in, no opening rush of ribbons or particles. Running text 16px or more.

name: Centred headline, art rising from the fold
description: One 100svh stage on one flat ground (the dealt ground or the ink field), the dealt navigation on top. The headline is centred in the upper half at the display step, two lines at most, its top about 130px from the screen top; an optional one-line sub at the lead step 24px under it, then the dealt button 32px under that. One large product cut-out (a transparent webp of the real product), 480-800px wide, centred and standing up from the bottom edge so that 30-40% of its height is cut by the hero's own bottom edge (the hero clips it; nothing of the next section appears); it sits on the bare ground. On scroll the headline scales to 80% and drifts up while the art scales to 115% and rises; hovering the art tilts it 4 degrees. Colour roles: ground flat; ink contrasting; accent only on the button.
signature: A transparent product cut-out 480-800px wide stands on the bottom edge with 30-40% of its height clipped by it, centred under a two-line headline on one flat ground, and grows on scroll.
phone: The headline at the display step in two lines at most; the art 85% of the width, cut by the bottom edge; the dealt button full width above it.
houseRuleCheck: The art is a photographed or rendered cut-out of the real product on bare ground: no colour disc behind it, no drawn picture, no side rules, no extra controls that switch product. The cut is made by the hero's own bottom edge.

name: Centred headline on flat colour with scattered cut-outs
description: One flat colour field (the dealt ground, or the ink field), 100svh, no photograph ground; the dealt navigation on top. The headline at the display step in two lines is centred in the upper half, leading 0.9, max 1300px wide; under it a one-line sub at the lead step (24px gap) and the dealt button 40px below that. Four to six die-cut product photographs (transparent webp, 120-200px, in different sizes) sit scattered close to the edges of the screen around the text, none touching it. Hover or focus: a cut-out tilts 8 degrees. Colour roles: ground flat; ink contrasting; accent = the button.
signature: Four to six die-cut product photographs of different sizes (120-200px) are scattered close to the screen edges around a centred two-line headline on one flat colour, each tilting 8 degrees on hover.
phone: The headline at the display step in two lines at most; the sub at the body step; the dealt button full width; three cut-outs near the corners.
houseRuleCheck: The cut-outs are photographed die-cut products, never drawn icons or stickers, and none sits behind a word. No policy line, gate or loader; the cut-outs stay still at rest and only hover tilts them.

name: Centred headline over full-screen picture, text at the corners
description: A full-screen photograph (or a looping clip when the page has one), 100svh, no overlay: the words sit on its calm parts (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only); the dealt navigation on top. The headline (or, for a name whose meaning the page is built on, the name) sits dead centre at the display step, one line or two at most, 12 words or fewer. Bottom-left, at the page margin from the left and 56px from the bottom: a title at the sub step (up to two lines, max 520px, 8 words) with the dealt button under it. Bottom-right, at the same inset: a paragraph of two or three lines at the body step (max 340px wide, 14 words). Nothing else. The words arrive with the dealt entrance. The pointer shifts the picture by 12px; over the first 30vh of scroll the headline fades and the text blocks lift away while the picture dims 40%. Colour roles: ground = the picture; text in the colour that reads on it; accent = the button.
signature: The headline sits dead centre on one full-bleed picture while a title with the dealt button holds the lower-left corner and a short paragraph the lower-right, both on the page margin and 56px from the bottom.
phone: The headline at the display step centred in two lines at most; the title and the dealt button stacked bottom-left at the margin; the paragraph cut to one line or hidden.
houseRuleCheck: Text blocks keep the page margin and 56px from the bottom; the paragraph is three lines at most; no rule or box around any block; the only button is the dealt one. The navigation is links only, no sentence. The words sit on the picture's calm part at every width.

name: Headline then wide media that grows
description: The dealt ground, one flat colour, 100svh, the dealt navigation on top. A one- or two-line headline centred at the display step, max 1000px wide, starting about 120px below the top; no sub; the dealt button 32px under it. 56px below the button one wide picture (a still of the product in use or, on a software page, a crop of the product's own interface), the dealt corner, full width less the page margins on both sides, 3:1 or wider, its top edge at about 52-55% of the screen height and its bottom edge 24px above the fold, so the whole composition ends inside the first screen with plain ground below it. The headline and button arrive with the dealt entrance. On scroll the picture pins and grows to full bleed (margins and corner go to 0) over 100vh while the headline slides up and out. Colour roles: the dealt ground and ink; accent only on the button.
signature: A wide picture (3:1 or wider) with the page margin on both sides fills the lower half of the first screen under a two-line headline and widens to full bleed as the page scrolls.
phone: The headline at the display step in two lines at most; the dealt button full width; the picture 4:5 or 1:1 inside the page margins filling the rest of the first screen; the same grow to full bleed over a 60vh pin.
houseRuleCheck: No label above the headline. The picture ends inside the first screen with ground below it, never cropped by the fold, so nothing of the next section shows. One pin of 100vh at most; do not pair it with the small move that widens a tile.

name: Centred picture-and-text pair with category chips
description: Exactly one screen (100svh) on the dealt ground, the dealt navigation on top. A centred group about 1200px wide, vertically centred in the space above the chip row: a picture on the left (a product shot or a photograph, about 460px wide, the dealt corner) and a text column about 640px wide on the right, 32px gap: the headline at the display step in two lines, then the dealt button 32px under it. Along the bottom, 64px up, a centred static row of 6-9 category links as chips on the surface tone (44px high, the dealt corner, body-size text, 12px gaps) that wraps to a second row on narrow screens. Hover: chips lift 4px and the fill darkens; the picture eases 1.03. The headline and button arrive with the dealt entrance. Colour roles: the dealt ground and ink, accent = the button.
signature: A centred picture-and-headline pair about 1200px wide sits above one static row of 6-9 filled category chips pinned 64px above the bottom edge of the first screen.
phone: The group stacks: the picture 16:10 on top, the headline at the display step in two lines at most, the dealt button full width; the chips wrap to two rows at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The picture is a product shot or a photograph, never a drawn picture; no rule, no carousel chevrons, no shadow; one button only; the chips are filled with the surface tone, never outlined, and take the dealt corner. Best for utility-led sites.

name: Centred title over full-bleed scene
description: One 100svh stage with the dealt navigation on top. The backdrop is one full-bleed photograph (or a looping clip when the page has one), cover fit, chosen or cropped so the words sit on one calm tone at every width (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only, never over the whole picture and never a gradient). The headline is centred on both axes at the display step (optical middle at about 46% of the height), one or two lines, 12 words or fewer, max 1100px wide, one colour. 24-32px under it one line at the lead step (max 44 characters, 70% opacity), and 32px under that the dealt button. Nothing else on the screen. The headline, line and button arrive with the dealt entrance. On scroll the picture scales 1.0 to 1.06 while the headline lifts away over the first 40% of the screen height. Colour roles: ground = the picture; text in whichever of the ink or the ground colour reads on it at 4.5:1; accent = the button only.
signature: One full-bleed photograph with the headline dead centre on its calm part (optical middle at about 46% of the height), the dealt button under it and nothing else on the screen.
phone: The same stack centred on a portrait crop of the photograph; the headline at the display step in two lines at most; the line under it at the body step; the dealt button as dealt for a phone, 32px above the safe area.
houseRuleCheck: The backdrop is a photograph or a clip, never a gradient stage and never darkened as a whole: the words sit on its calm part, of one tone at every width (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). No label above the headline, no partner logos, no second action.

name: Lone centred word with three-part foot row
description: A one-screen hero on the dealt ground, 100svh, the dealt navigation on top. A single bold word dead centre at the display step, one line (a word of the page's own idea, in the display face, leading 0.9), the only display element. Along the bottom, 80px up and inside the page margins, one three-part row on one baseline at the body step: left a place and a date, centre a two-line sentence (max 300px, 12 words, centred), right the dealt button. The word and the row arrive with the dealt entrance. Colour roles: the dealt ground and ink, accent = the button.
signature: One bold word at the display step stands alone dead centre of an otherwise bare screen, with a three-part foot row on one baseline 80px above the bottom edge: place and date left, a two-line sentence centre, the dealt button right.
phone: The word at the display step on one line (two stacked if long); the foot row becomes two rows: the place and date, then the sentence, then the full-width dealt button.
houseRuleCheck: No issue number, tiny caption, partner logo or icon row; the foot row is a place and a date, one sentence and one button. The word is a word of the page's idea, not the company name, and no hover effect colours it.

name: Colour-block collage, crossing headline
description: The first screen, 100svh, is cut into three hard flat blocks of the palette: a block top-left (about 62% wide, 55% tall) on the ground, a block bottom-left (62% wide, the remaining height) on the surface tone, and one block on the right (38% wide, full height) on the ink field. The dealt navigation sits over the blocks. Across all blocks a two-line headline at the display step, leading 0.9, is set bottom-left so its words cross the block edges. It is drawn once per ink (the extra copies hidden from screen readers, each clipped to its blocks), so letters change colour exactly where a block edge cuts them. The dealt button sits in the bottom-left block under the headline. No picture, no discs, no gradient. The pointer shifts the block boundaries by up to 4% (smooth); on scroll the blocks hold and the next section starts on the ground. Colour roles: the ground, the surface tone and the ink field only, plus their inks; the accent is the button.
signature: Three hard flat blocks (62% by 55% top-left, 62% by 45% bottom-left, 38% full height right) fill the first screen and the two-line headline crosses their edges, its letters switching ink exactly at the edge of the ink-field block.
phone: The blocks re-cut into three full-width horizontal bands (ground, surface tone, ink field); the headline at the display step crosses the band edges at the bottom with the same clipped copies; the dealt button sits in the last band above the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Three flat tones of the palette (ground, surface, ink field), no fourth colour, no blended discs, no gradient. One real h1; the clipped copies are decoration.

name: Corner title over 3D canvas
description: A screen exactly 100svh on a dark stage (the page ground on a dark page, the ink field on a light one) with a full-bleed canvas scene (a real 3D scene, not a drawn field of particles) whose upper part stays calm so the navigation reads; no layer over it, no gradient. The dealt navigation on top. Top-left a short paragraph at the body step (max 280px, 70% opacity, 18 words). The headline in sentence case at the display step, two lines, leading 0.9, flush to the right and set at the page margin from the right and 48px from the bottom, tilted by CSS perspective (rotateY -12 degrees, rotateX 4 degrees) so it recedes to the right. Bottom-left the dealt button, on the headline's last baseline. On scroll the headline straightens to 0 degrees while the camera moves forward. Colour roles: the dark stage, type in the lighter of the ground and the ink, accent = the scene's one key colour and the button.
signature: The two-line headline sits bottom-right on a dark canvas, tilted by CSS perspective (rotateY -12 degrees) so it recedes to the right, and straightens to 0 degrees as the camera moves forward on scroll.
phone: The headline at the display step in two lines at the bottom-right inside the page margin, tilt reduced to 6 degrees; the paragraph top-left at the body step; the dealt button full width under the headline.
houseRuleCheck: The headline stays inside the page margin on the right and 48px above the bottom; no fade or layer over the top, the scene keeps it calm; the paragraph is in the page's sans, never code type; the scene is a real 3D model or render, not drawn particles or lines.

name: Depth cloud of image planes
description: The dealt ground, 100svh, the dealt navigation on top. Six photographs scattered across the screen at three depths (CSS 3D, perspective 1200px): two near planes large (260-340px wide), two middle (180-240px), two far (110-150px, smaller and at 70% opacity, never blurred). All keep the dealt corner and the one grade. A clear zone of about 760x280px in the centre holds the headline at the display step in two lines, centred, so no text sits on a picture; the dealt button sits 32px under it. The planes and the text are there in the first frame; the planes shift with the pointer by depth, and on scroll they drift upward at depth-based speeds. Colour roles: the dealt ground and ink, accent = the button.
signature: Six photographs at three sizes hang around a clear text-only centre of about 760x280px that holds the headline, near ones 260-340px wide and far ones 110-150px, shifting against each other with the pointer.
phone: Four planes at 60% scale around a clear centre; the headline at the display step in two lines at most; the dealt button full width; a slow depth shift on scroll instead of the pointer.
houseRuleCheck: Six photographs at most, each once on the page, in colour, never blurred; styled or product pictures, never documentary or archive; no plane gets a card; no text on a picture and no picture between the words of the headline.

name: Inset canvas with tilted interface, scrubbed
description: A flat page frame (the dealt ground) with a canvas inset 18px on all sides (the dealt corner) filling 100svh; the canvas stands on the surface tone. Inside it, one crop of the product's own interface (or the product cut-out), no bezel and no device frame, tilted in CSS 3D by 10-14 degrees and 40-50% of the height, stands on the canvas. The headline at the display step in two lines and a one-line sub at the lead step sit top-left, 40px in; the dealt navigation sits on top of the canvas; bottom-right the dealt button. Pinned for 150vh: scroll shifts the canvas between two flat tones (the surface tone to the ground) while the interface moves 15% closer (scale 1.15), and at the end the frame's inset and corner animate to 0 so the canvas becomes the next section's ground. Colour roles: frame = the ground; canvas = the surface tone; ink the dealt ink; accent = the button.
signature: The canvas is inset 18px inside a flat frame with the dealt corner and holds one tilted crop of the product's interface (40-50% of its height); on scroll the inset and the corner go to 0 so the canvas becomes the next ground.
phone: Frame 10px; the headline at the display step top-left; the interface crop at 70% of the width, centred; the dealt button full width at the bottom; scroll length 120vh.
houseRuleCheck: Lighting changes as flat tone shifts, never a gradient. No popover or card over the scene, no device frame, no drawn laptop or phone, no play button for a film. The interface crop is the only framed window on the page. The pin is 150vh at most.

name: Full-height picture, mid-left copy
description: A 100svh cover picture (or a looping clip when the page has one) bleeding to all edges with the words on its calm left part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), no gradient; the dealt navigation on top. A left-anchored block starting at about 10% of the width, vertically at 55%: the headline at the display step in two lines (max 600px) and, 56px under it, the dealt button. The right half stays empty so the subject of the picture sits there. When a clip plays, one pause control in the dealt button's shape sits bottom-right at the page margin. The headline and button arrive with the dealt entrance. On scroll the picture dims 40% and the block lifts out in 0.5s. Colour roles: ground = the picture; text in the colour that reads on it; accent = the button.
signature: The headline block sits left at about 10% of the width and 55% of the height on one full-bleed picture, and the whole right half is left empty for the picture's subject.
phone: The headline at the display step bottom-left in two lines at most with the dealt button full width under it; object-position keeps the subject above the text.
houseRuleCheck: No layer over the picture and never a gradient (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only); the button is solid, never translucent. The open right half is for the subject. Pair it with a distinctive, styled picture: it is the plainest media hero.

name: Slide loop with centre-line text row
description: Four full-screen cover-fit pictures, each with a calm band across its middle where the row sits (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), advancing on a 6-second timer (it pauses when the tab is hidden) and by arrow keys; each next picture wipes in from the bottom (clip-path inset from 100% to 0, 0.9s, ease-in-out). The headline, the page's one h1, is fixed dead centre on the vertical middle at the display step, one line, 6 words or fewer. Across the same centre line, inside the page margins: at the left edge the project's place and year, at the right edge its category, both at the lead step and swapping with each picture; the three items share one baseline. The dealt button sits 56px under the row. The dealt navigation sits on top. The headline and button arrive with the dealt entrance. No slide counter, no progress line, no dots, and no wheel hijack: the page scrolls natively. Colour roles: ground = the picture; text in the colour that reads on it; accent = the button.
signature: One horizontal row crosses the vertical centre of a full-screen picture: place and year hard left, the headline dead centre, the category hard right, all on one baseline, while the picture wipes up from the bottom every 6 seconds.
phone: The row stacks: the headline centred at the display step in two lines at most, with the place and year, then the category, on one body-size line under it; swipe advances; the timer pauses when the tab is hidden.
houseRuleCheck: No slide counter, progress line or dots. The year is a plain date. Pictures are styled, modern and in colour, never archive or documentary shots. The first picture is in place at load; only the later ones wipe in.

name: Half photo with straddling title
description: A split 100svh with the dealt navigation on top. The left 58%: one photograph (the dealt corner) from under the navigation to 24px above the bottom edge, with the page margin to its left. The headline at the display step in two lines, in one face, a whole phrase, starts so its first letters overlap the photograph's right edge by 80-140px: it is drawn twice, one copy clipped to the photograph in the colour that reads on its calm part and one clipped to the ground in the ink (the extra copy hidden from screen readers), so the letters change colour exactly at the edge; the overlap lands on the photograph's calm part. Right of the photograph, under the headline: a paragraph at the lead step of up to three lines (max 380px, 18 words) and the dealt button. Nothing else; no card over the photograph. Hover on the button: the photograph scales 1.03 inside its frame. Colour roles: the dealt ground and ink; accent = the button.
signature: One photograph holds the left 58% of the first screen and the two-line headline straddles its right edge, its letters switching colour exactly at that edge.
phone: The photograph full width on top (52% of the height) inside the page margins; the headline at the display step starts at the margin and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge with the same two-copy clip; the paragraph and the dealt button below.
houseRuleCheck: No label, dash, side rule, tab strip or card over the photograph. The headline is one face, a whole phrase, never one picked-out word.

name: Headline band over centred round object
description: A one-screen cover on the dealt ground, with the page margins. Top: the headline at the display step in two lines across the full content width, in the ink. Middle: one round object centred in the free height, about 350px on a phone and 520px at 1440, a rendered or photographed disc form as a cut-out (a record, a dial, a coin or a lens, whichever belongs to the brand), lit from one side, tilting a few degrees with the pointer. Bottom: a one-line sub at the lead step with the dealt button beside it, and under it a one-line note at the body step in the muted ink. Colour roles: ground, ink, the accent only on the dealt button. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A two-line headline across the top over one round, side-lit object centred in the free height (about 520px at 1440), with only a sub, the action and a note at the foot.
phone: The headline at the display step on two lines at the top, the 350px object centred in the free height, the sub, the dealt button and the note at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The centrepiece is a rendered or photographed round object, never a drawn dial with rings, ticks or numerals; no giant name: the headline says something, it is not the logo.

name: Headline band over scattered stills and search
description: One screen split into two bands, nothing of the next section showing. Top band (about 38% of the height, on the ground): at the left the headline at the display step in two lines; at the right a one-sentence sub at the lead step over the dealt button. Lower band (the surface tone as one flat field, with no rules or grid): six stills (the dealt corner, widths 140 to 260, mixed portrait and landscape) scattered across the width inside the page margins, and a search field 640px wide and 64px tall on the ground colour with the dealt corner, centred low in the band. The field works: three suggested words under it (plain text links), or the visitor's own typing, lift the stills that carry that word and drop the rest to 60% opacity; with nothing typed all six stand at rest. Stills are art-directed or product pictures, never documentary. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: Six scattered stills on a flat field around a 640px search field that really filters them (matching stills lift, the rest drop to 60%), under a two-line headline band.
phone: Top band holds the headline and the dealt button; the lower band shows four stills in two columns and the search field at full width near the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: No ruled or graph-paper ground and no translucent dock; every still inside the page margins and each used once, six at most; the field filters for real, never a field that does nothing; art-directed or product pictures only.

name: Headline over filled fact rows
description: A one-screen cover with the page margins. Top: the headline at the display step in two lines, left aligned. A band of open ground follows, under half the screen. Anchored to the bottom: three filled rows (each 64px tall, on the surface tone, 8px apart, the dealt corner), every row a two-column pair with a label at the body step in the left column and a value at the lead step in the right column (role, place, year or other plain facts), and under them the dealt button at the left. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. Colour roles: ground and surface tone, one accent on the dealt button. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: Three filled fact rows (label left, value right, 8px apart) sit at the foot of the screen under a two-line headline, with no bar, rule or table lines.
phone: The rows stay full width inside the 24px margin; the headline at the display step on two lines; the dealt button full width under the rows.
houseRuleCheck: Filled rows with gaps, never rules; three rows at most so it never becomes a credit wall; labels at the body step in sentence case, never tiny capitals; no accent bar or giant wordmark; the open ground between headline and rows stays under half the screen.

name: Headline with wedged sub and button
description: A full-screen art-directed photograph with a calm centre where the column sits (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), with a slow ripple moving through the picture (a gentle displacement, no colour change). A centred column about 830px wide holds the headline in two lines at the display step, lettered in whichever of ground and ink is lighter; each line is short enough to leave a gap in its row. Line 1 is pushed to the right by a two-line sub at the lead step set directly in the gap to its left, with no box; line 2 has the dealt button wedged into the gap to its right. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. It arrives with the dealt entrance; on scroll the column stays while the ripple speeds up. The accent only on the dealt button.
signature: Two short headline lines whose gaps carry the content: the sub sits directly in the gap at the left of line 1 and the dealt button in the gap at the right of line 2, all in one centred 830px column with no boxes.
phone: The headline at the display step on two lines; the sub and the dealt button stack under the headline.
houseRuleCheck: Two lines at most; no tint over the picture; the wedged sub is plain type, no box; one button, the dealt one; no giant name.

name: Inset photo frame with text at the foot
description: Ground as dealt. One photo frame fills the first screen inset by the page margin on all four sides (about 1344x756 at 1440x900), with the dealt corner, entirely inside the first screen, nothing of the next section showing. The lettering sits on the photo's calm lower part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only, no gradient). Inside the frame at its foot, on the photo's calm part, lettered in whichever of ground and ink is lighter: at the left the headline at the display step in two lines; at the right, on the same baseline, a one-sentence sub at the lead step over the dealt button. The upper part of the frame stays open photograph. The dealt navigation sits as dealt; the hero adds no rail, bar, chip or menu of its own. On scroll the photo drifts at 0.9 speed inside the frame (parallax inside the mask) while the frame stays still. It arrives with the dealt entrance. Colour roles: ground, ink and the photograph; the accent only on the dealt button.
signature: One photo frame inset by the page margin on all four sides with the headline at its bottom left and the sub and action at its bottom right, the upper two thirds open photograph: not a centred headline over a rounded card.
phone: The frame is inset by the 24px phone margin with the dealt corner and fills the screen; the headline at the display step on two lines at its foot, the sub and the dealt button full width beneath it.
houseRuleCheck: No rail, bar, chip or menu of its own; not a centred headline over a rounded card (the text sits at the foot, left and right); text on the photo's calm part, never a tint over the whole photo or a gradient (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only); one accent, on the dealt button.

name: Inset rounded video, bottom-left headline
description: The page ground shows as an even 12-16px frame on all four sides around a rounded film (the dealt corner) that fills the first screen (100svh minus the frame). The dealt navigation sits inside the frame at the top. Anchored bottom-left inside the film, at the page margin: the headline at the display step, one or two lines, in one face, max 1000px wide; bottom-right the dealt button. The words sit on the film's calm lower part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). On scroll the film scales to 0.94 and dims 30% while the headline holds for the first 60vh. Colour roles: frame = the page ground; text in the colour that reads on the film; accent = the button.
signature: The film sits inside an even 12-16px frame of page ground on all four sides, with the dealt corner, the headline anchored bottom-left inside it and the dealt button bottom-right; on scroll the film shrinks to 94%.
phone: Frame 8px; the headline at the display step bottom-left in two lines at most with the dealt button full width under it.
houseRuleCheck: No label above the headline and no card on the film. The frame is equal on all four sides and the text keeps the page margin inside it.

name: Intro column left, headline and window right
description: Ground as dealt, a 12-column grid with the page margins, filling exactly one screen. Columns 1 to 4: a short intro at the lead step (three lines at most) at the top and, at the foot of the column, the dealt button, so the column never sits empty. Columns 5 to 12: the headline at the display step in two lines starting at the top, and beneath it a photo window 8 columns wide with the dealt corner that runs down to the bottom page margin, so the whole window (about 860x540 at 1440x900) sits inside the first screen and nothing of the next section shows. As the page scrolls the photo moves inside the window at 0.8 speed (parallax inside the mask). The dealt navigation sits as dealt. It arrives with the dealt entrance. Colour roles: ground, ink and the photograph; the accent only on the dealt button.
signature: The headline starts at column 5 above an 8-column photo window that ends exactly at the bottom page margin, while the left four columns hold only a short intro at the top and the action at the foot.
phone: Single column: the headline at the display step on two lines, the intro at the body step, the dealt button, then the photo window full width at 4:5 with parallax inside, all within the first screen.
houseRuleCheck: No bracketed tag, ghost mark or translucent layer; text is the lead step or larger except the navigation; the left column always holds the button so it never sits empty; the window ends at the bottom margin, never under the fold.

name: Justified statement across full width
description: Ground as dealt, one full screen, page margins, nothing of the next section showing. In the middle of the screen a headline of two lines at the display step (about ten words), both lines justified so each fills the full content width (text-align-last: justify, tracking as dealt). The words alternate strictly one by one between the dealt display weight and the dealt strong weight of the same family, so no single word reads as the accent. Beneath it, on one baseline 40px under the headline: a one-line sub at the lead step at the left and the dealt button at the right. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. It arrives with the dealt entrance; on scroll the block holds and tightens. Ink on ground; the accent only on the dealt button.
signature: A two-line display headline justified edge to edge across the content width with every other word in the heavier weight, and nothing else on the screen but a one-line sub and the action beneath it.
phone: The headline is the short form (six words or fewer) on two justified lines at the display step with the same word-by-word alternation; the sub left aligned in two lines; the dealt button full width.
houseRuleCheck: One family, alternating by weight on every word, never on a single word; two lines at most at every width; no name line, bracket or dot above the headline; the hero fills the screen alone.

name: Left headline over 3D hall
description: A full-screen 3D interior (a hall or room with a few points of light in the accent) on a dark stage (the page ground on a dark page, the ink field on a light one). Colour roles: the dark stage, type in the lighter of the ground and the ink, the accent on the dealt button. A left block starts at the left page margin and is vertically centred: a two-line headline at the display step and under it a one-line sub at the lead step. The dealt button sits at the bottom right on the page margins. The dealt navigation sits as dealt; the hero adds no emblem, sound or language toggles. Scrolling flies the camera into the hall while the left block lifts away; the dealt button scrolls the same way. The stage is pinned for about 1.5 screens. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A dark rendered hall with a two-line headline at the left and the camera flying into the room over the first 1.5 screens of scroll, the dealt button anchored bottom right.
phone: Headline at the display step on two lines at the 24px left margin, the dealt button full width at the bottom, the camera starts a little lower.
houseRuleCheck: No giant name or logotype and no label above the headline; no emblem, toggles or pulsing button; one accent on the dealt button; the pin is 1.5 screens.

name: Left lockup over 3D landscape
description: A fixed full-viewport 3D landscape (terrain, a low sun and a cloud deck, in three flat tones taken from the palette: the ground, the surface tone and the one accent for the light) is the hero's ground. At mid-height, left of centre (starting near x 240): the brand mark at the display step's height (the client's own; if it has none, the headline alone) and, to its right at a 24px gap, the headline at the display step in two lines, with a one-line sub at the lead step under them. The dealt navigation sits as dealt; nothing else stands on the screen. Over about 720px of scroll the camera sinks down into the cloud layer, the landscape settles on the next section's ground colour and the headline fades out. The first screen holds the mark, the headline, the sub and the navigation only. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A rendered landscape (low sun, cloud deck) behind a left-of-centre mark and two-line headline, where 720px of scroll sinks the camera into the clouds until the next section's ground replaces the scene.
phone: The mark above the headline, both left aligned at the phone margin at about 40% height; the camera path runs vertically.
houseRuleCheck: No divider between the mark and the headline and no scroll hint; the scene is a rendered landscape in three flat palette tones, no gradient sky; the first screen is the hero alone, the next section arriving only after the camera descent.

name: Masked 3D island with headline
description: Full-bleed 3D world, first screen, on a dark stage (the page ground on a dark page, the ink field on a light one). A shader mask uncovers a single disc-shaped island (about 555x300 on screen at 1440, an ellipse in perspective, with a crisp lit rim in the one accent hue) in the upper half, centred; inside it a small diorama of a few lit modelled forms idles with a slow turn. The floor outside the island is a field of dim dots in perspective (no lines). Beneath the island the headline at the display step in two lines, with the dealt button under it. The dealt navigation sits as dealt; the hero adds no menu or sound toggle. Pinned for about one screen: scrolling expands the island until it fills the view and the next section replaces it. The scene is complete in the first frame and arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A lone lit disc-shaped island with a slowly turning diorama floats in a dim dot field with the headline beneath it; scrolling expands the island to fill the screen.
phone: The island 80% of the width in the upper half, the headline at the display step on two lines beneath it, the dealt button under that; scrolling expands it the same way.
houseRuleCheck: The floor is dots, never grid lines; the rim is a crisp lit edge, no glow; no start gate, sound toggle or menu of its own; the headline is set type, not a drawn picture.

name: Object with a rolling word
description: Hero on the ground as dealt, filling the first screen alone. One tilted glossy product or brand form (a rendered or photographed cut-out on a clean ground, about 420px tall, no frame) sits dead centre and tilts a few degrees toward the pointer. To the left of its upper half, not over it: the headline at the display step in two lines, the second line a single word held in a window clipped to one line that rolls vertically like an odometer through three short words (a verb, an adjective, the brand promise), one every 3 seconds, and rests on the brand promise. The first frame already shows the headline finished on the brand promise; the roll pauses on hover and stops under reduced motion. The rolling word has the same face, weight and ink as the rest. The dealt button sits under the headline. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. Nothing rolls or loads on arrival: it arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A tilted glossy object dead centre with a clipped one-word window in the headline that rolls through three words every 3 seconds and rests on the brand promise.
phone: The object at 60% of the width centred, the headline above it with the rolling word as its second line, the dealt button under the object.
houseRuleCheck: Rolling words, never digits; no counter, loader or status bar; no captions on the edges; the rolling word keeps the headline's own style and the first frame is complete.

name: Offset 3D logo in ring relief
description: A full-viewport canvas rendered in three flat tones made only from the palette (the ground, the surface tone and the ink at the ridge tops; no new hue), shaded in hard bands (toon shading) so each tone is flat and no smooth ramp shows. Embossed rounded-square bands radiate outward from a soft blob that holds a 3D rendition of the brand mark (the client's own mark, or its initial extruded in the display face). The blob sits off-centre at about 75% across and 74% down, so the left half of the screen is open ring field; the bands widen toward the edges and ripple slowly, and the pointer pushes a soft wave through them while the mark tilts with it. In the open left half: the headline at the display step in two lines and under it the dealt button. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: Concentric embossed rounded-square bands in three flat tones radiate from an off-centre 3D mark (about 75% across, 74% down), rippling under the pointer, with the headline in the open left half.
phone: The mark placed at 60% down and centred, bands tighter, the headline at the display step above it, the dealt button at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Shading banded into three flat tones, never a smooth ramp; the relief is a lit render, not outlined lines or drawn shapes; one accent, on the dealt button only.

name: Photo arc with stepping labels
description: The dealt ground, the first screen complete from the first frame. Five portrait photo cards (each about 230x320, the dealt corner, art-directed pictures) stand on an upward arc across the upper half of the screen, 220px apart and tilted outward along the arc (-12, -6, 0, +6, +12 degrees). Under each card an upright one-word label at the sub step (no rotated letters), the five labels being the page's categories. Every 3 seconds the next card steps forward: it lifts 24px and rises to full opacity with its label in the ink, while the others rest at 70% opacity with their labels in the muted ink; hover or focus pauses the step, and reduced motion stops it. Below the arc: the headline at the display step in two lines at the left and the dealt button at the right. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. The dealt ink, the accent only on the dealt button.
signature: Five portrait cards fan on an upward arc (tilts from -12 to +12 degrees, 220px apart) with an upright one-word label under each, and every 3 seconds the next card lifts 24px to full opacity.
phone: Three cards on the arc, the labels at the lead step, the headline at the display step, the dealt button; the step runs on its own timer.
houseRuleCheck: Labels stay upright at the sub step, no text set along a curve and no drawn dial, circle or rule; art-directed pictures only; five cards, each used once; a two-line headline.

name: Photo with left copy and right quote
description: A full-bleed art-directed photograph with a calm middle band where both blocks sit (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only, no gradient). Two balanced blocks share the middle band, both vertically centred: the left block at the left page margin holds the headline at the display step in two lines and the dealt button; the right block (about 460 wide, its right edge on the page margin) is one short quote of at most 12 words set directly on the photo at the sub step, with the speaker's name and role beneath it at the body step, no box and no panel. The first screen stays within 30 words, so there is no sub under the headline. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. It arrives with the dealt entrance; on scroll the two blocks drift apart by 40px while the photo scales slowly. Lettering in whichever of ground and ink is lighter; the accent only on the dealt button.
signature: Two text blocks share the middle band of one photograph: headline and action at the left, a short quote with the speaker's name set directly on the photo at the right, no panel.
phone: The left block only; the quote sits under it at the lead step, or is dropped when the photo is busy.
houseRuleCheck: The quote sits on the photo as plain type, no panel, card or glass; it is a real quote with a real name, never invented; text on the photo's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only); nothing above the navigation and no scroll hint.

name: Pinned render with halftone dissolve
description: A full-bleed 3D render or product photograph pinned for about 1.5 screens of scroll with its lower part calm where the words sit (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only, no gradient). Lower left: the headline at the display step in two lines. Lower right: one real figure set inside a one-line sentence at the lead step (a static number, never counting up) above the dealt button. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. On scroll the headline and the sentence slide up and out, the picture zooms to 1.15 and breaks into a halftone-dot field in the next section's ground colour through a shader, the dots growing as the picture dissolves, until the field is one flat ground. Lettering in whichever of ground and ink is lighter; one accent, on the dealt button. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A full-bleed render under a two-line headline that, over about 1.5 screens of scroll, zooms to 1.15 and breaks into growing halftone dots that settle into the next section's flat ground.
phone: The headline at the display step on two lines, the figure sentence beneath, the dealt button; the same dissolve over 1.5 screens.
houseRuleCheck: A static figure inside a sentence, never counting up and never a figures band; no label or meta row; no tint over the picture and no gradient at rest; the dots exist only during the dissolve and end as a flat ground.

name: Image sequence shrinking into a card
description: Pinned for about 1.5 screens: a full-screen scrubbed sequence (60 to 120 frames on a canvas) of one product turning sits on the dealt ground, which steps to the surface tone by a flat colour change as you scroll (no gradient). Bottom left at the page margin: the headline at the display step in two lines, a one-line sub at the lead step, the dealt button and the dealt second action. On scroll the copy fades, the product turns a quarter turn as the ground steps, then the full-screen canvas shrinks into a filled tile (about 960x560, the dealt corner, filled with the ground) centred on the screen and the next scene begins around it. Colour roles: the dealt ground stepping to the surface tone, the ink, the accent only on the dealt button. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. The first frame is complete and it arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: One product turns on a full-screen scrubbed sequence while the headline fades, and the whole canvas then shrinks into a centred tile (about 960x560, dealt corner) over 1.5 screens of scroll.
phone: A portrait sequence, the headline at the display step on two lines, the dealt button full width, the tile 90% of the width.
houseRuleCheck: No kicker or labelled thumbnail; the ground changes as a flat colour, never a gradient; the final tile is a filled picture with the dealt corner, never outlined; the pin is 1.5 screens at most.

name: Title relay over wiping videos
description: A pinned stage of about two screens of scroll with three full-bleed videos stacked; each slides up from below in turn and wipes the previous one (about 0.65 screen of scroll each). The active title sits top-left at the page margin at the display step (the h1, one to three words) and the waiting titles stack right-aligned beneath it at the sub step in the muted ink, ending on the right page margin. On each swap the next title grows from its queue position into the top-left slot while the old one shrinks away to the right and exits, and the queue re-forms. The dealt button sits bottom right on the page margin. The titles sit on calm parts of the footage (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). The dealt navigation sits as dealt. The first frame is complete and it arrives with the dealt entrance. Lettering in whichever of ground and ink is lighter; the accent only on the dealt button.
signature: Pinned for two screens: the active title top-left at the display step with the waiting titles queued right-aligned beneath it, and each scroll step swaps them while the next full-bleed video slides up over the last.
phone: The active title at the display step top left, the waiting titles at the lead step stacked beneath and right-aligned, the videos wipe the same way over two screens.
houseRuleCheck: The queue sits on the right page margin; no labels or counters; the pin is two screens at most; titles are one to three words so the active title stays on one or two lines.

name: Round demo window with headline column
description: A full-screen canvas on the dealt ground, ink as dealt, one accent on the dealt button. A round demo window about 640px across, centred at about 65% across so the left column keeps room, holds a fragment of the product's own interface (built in HTML, data-ui, no video) cropped to a circle, with nothing around it: no disc, frame, tick marks, segments or rings. Left column at the left page margin: the headline at the display step in two lines, a one-sentence sub at the lead step, the dealt button and the dealt second action. Bottom right: a one-line fact at the body step. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. The stage is pinned for about one screen: on scroll the circle grows (a clip-path radius) until the interface fills the screen. The first frame is complete and it arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A circular crop of the product's own interface, about 640px across at 65% across, that grows on scroll until it fills the screen, beside a left column with a two-line headline.
phone: The headline at the display step at the top, the 300px round window beneath it, then the dealt button.
houseRuleCheck: The window is a plain circular crop of the product interface: no disc, tick marks, segments or rings around it; no code chip or code face; the product is shown at least half the screen high; one framed window only.

name: Scrubbed film with typed statements
description: A pinned stage 200vh tall (two screens of scroll). A full-viewport film (cover fit) whose currentTime is mapped to scroll progress, or a canvas drawing a sequence of 120-240 webp frames at 1920 wide. One centred statement sits on the stage at the display step, two lines at most, 10 words or fewer, in one face, leading 1.0; the first statement is there in the first frame. The dealt button sits 32px under it from the first frame to the end of the pin. As the scroll runs, the statement is replaced once or twice (two or three statements in all) by the next: each builds in place word by word over about 400px of scroll behind a plain 2px bar caret, the block keeping its bottom line fixed so the text grows upward. The dealt navigation stays on top. When the pin ends the stage unpins and the next section scrolls over it. Colour roles: ground the film; the statement in the lighter of the ground and the ink, on the film's calm middle (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only); accent only on the button.
signature: A full-viewport film scrubs with the scroll under one centred display statement that rewrites itself word by word from the same bottom line, two or three times inside a 200vh pin.
phone: A portrait crop of the film or a second 9:16 frame set; statements at the display step in two lines at most; pin 150vh; with reduced motion show one frame and the first statement whole, with no pin.
houseRuleCheck: Three statements at most, each two lines or fewer. The caret is a plain 2px bar. The dealt button is there from the first frame. The pin holds two screens at most and every step shows a statement, never an empty frame.

name: Shaped window cut in a flat plane
description: A full-screen plane of one flat colour (the ground, or one field colour of the palette; ink contrasting) laid over a fixed canvas of photographs. In the plane a hole about 650px across, centred in the upper part of the screen: a crisp plain hexagon (about 690x580) or a circle. Through it shows one photograph, or a collage of up to three photographs. In the strip below the hole, at the left page margin: the headline at the display step in two lines in the ink on the plane, with the dealt button beneath it. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. Over about one screen of scroll the hole widens until the photograph fills the screen and the next scene replaces the plane. Variant with words: the headline's last word cycles every 3 seconds through three words, each with its own photograph inside the hole, all words in one style. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: One flat colour plane with a single hexagonal window about 650px across showing a photograph, which widens on scroll until the photograph fills the screen.
phone: The hole 90% of the width (a tall hexagon in that variant), the headline beneath it at the display step on two lines, the dealt button under that; scrolling widens it the same way.
houseRuleCheck: The hole is a crisp plain polygon or circle, never loose drawn blobs and no pointer ripple; the cycling word keeps the style of the other words; colour is the plane, the ink and the photographs.

name: Type-only hero with left headline
description: A full-screen type-only hero with no media. Ground as dealt, ink as dealt, the accent only on the dealt button. The headline sits at the left page margin across about 55% of the width in the upper half of the screen: the display step in two lines, tracking as dealt, one face throughout and no accent word. Anchored bottom right, in columns 8 to 12: a two-line sub at the lead step in the muted ink and the dealt button, so the composition runs on a diagonal and the open ground beside the headline is balanced by the text below it. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. It arrives with the dealt entrance; on scroll the headline slides 80px left and fades.
signature: A two-line display headline at the top left across 55% of the width and the sub with the action at the bottom right, the two groups on a diagonal with nothing else on the screen.
phone: The headline at the display step on two lines, the sub at the body step, the dealt button full width at the bottom, the open space between them under half the screen.
houseRuleCheck: One face throughout, no accent word, no badges or plus marks; a full screen with the open ground between the two text groups under half of it, never one side left empty.

name: Type half beside photo strips, panning
description: A hard 50/50 split pinned for about two screens of scroll. Left half on the ground: the headline at the display step in two lines, a one-sentence sub at the lead step and the dealt button, vertically centred; the dealt navigation sits as dealt, with no links or social row of its own. Right half: three full-height strips on the surface tone with the dealt corner, inset by the page margin at the outer edges and 12px apart, widths in the ratio 5:3:2, each holding one photograph placed at a different height (top, middle, bottom) so the row reads staggered. On scroll the left half slides out to the left and the strips pan sideways and open into project panels, each a large photograph with a short title at the sub step beneath it, driven by scroll alone (no drag, no bar). It arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A hard 50/50 split: headline and action on the left, three full-height strips (widths 5:3:2, photographs at staggered heights) on the right, and on scroll the left half slides out while the strips pan sideways and open into project panels.
phone: The headline and the dealt button on top, the three strips as three horizontal bands beneath them; on scroll they pan vertically into the project panels.
houseRuleCheck: Strips inset by the page margin; fills are the ground and the surface tone only; no panel numbers or progress bar; scroll alone pans, never a drag; no giant name; the pin is two screens.

name: Statements over a veiled cut-out
description: A fixed canvas: a cut-out object (a product or a thing the page is about, photographed or rendered, never drawn, about 715px tall, slightly right of centre) stands on the ground. A veil in the ground colour at about 85% opacity covers it except where a crisp circular lens of about 260px (a hard edge, no feathering) follows the cursor and shows the object in full colour. At the left page margin: a two-line statement at the display step in the ink, with the dealt button beneath it. Pinned for about two screens of scroll: every ~0.6 screen the statement changes in place to the next of three (two lines at most each) and the lens widens by 20px, finishing with the veil fully lifted. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. The first frame is complete and it arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: A cut-out object veiled in the ground colour except a crisp circular lens that follows the cursor, beside a two-line statement that changes three times over a two-screen pin while the lens widens until the veil is gone.
phone: The statement at the display step at the top, the object beneath it; the lens drifts by itself on a slow figure-of-eight instead of following a pointer.
houseRuleCheck: The veil is one flat tone at one opacity and the lens a hard-edged circle (no feathered mask, no blur, no glass); each statement two lines at most; a cut-out photograph or render, never a painting or drawing.

name: Stepped title over parallax picture
description: A full-bleed art-directed photograph (or a portrait made as a raster picture) with gentle pointer parallax (the picture shifts about 12px inside its frame) with a calm part where the headline sits (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). The dealt navigation sits as dealt; the hero adds no bar. A two-line headline at the display step, lettered in whichever of ground and ink is lighter, sits at the left with its lines stepped one of two ways: line 2 set one step in from line 1 (a staircase of about 70px: x 64, 134), or the irregular jump (line 1 at x 120, line 2 jumping right to x 640). A one-line sub at the lead step with the dealt button sits at the lower right on the page margins. It arrives with the dealt entrance; on scroll the lines step further apart (in the jump version they slide in opposite directions) while the picture scales to 1.05.
signature: A two-line headline whose second line steps in (about 70px) or jumps right (to about 40% across) from the first, over a full-bleed photograph, with the sub and action at the lower right.
phone: The headline at the display step with 24px steps, the sub and the dealt button beneath it, a portrait cropped to the face, scroll parallax instead of pointer parallax.
houseRuleCheck: No bar across the top, no line frame, no line indexes, no loader, no grain overlay and no scroll hint; two lines at most; a photograph or raster portrait, never a vector drawing or a documentary photo; text on the picture's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only).

name: Tall product screen rising from the fold
description: A stage on the dealt ground, 100svh, the dealt navigation on top. The headline sits centred in the upper part at the display step in two lines, with the dealt button 32px under it. Below it, one phone-proportioned crop of the product's own interface (built in HTML at real size, in the page's own palette, no bezel and no device frame), about 740px tall at 1440, rises from about 45% of the screen height and runs past the bottom edge so its lower third is cut by the hero's own bottom edge; its text 14px or more, its labels real. Behind the crop nothing but the ground. The headline and button arrive with the dealt entrance. Scroll lifts the crop 80px. Colour roles: ground the dealt ground; ink the dealt ink; accent = the button and the one selected item in the interface.
signature: A phone-proportioned crop of the product's own interface, about 740px tall and without a bezel, rises from the lower half of the first screen and is cut by the bottom edge, under a two-line headline and the dealt button.
phone: The crop 78% of the width rising from the middle of the screen; the headline at the display step in two lines at most above it; the dealt button full width.
houseRuleCheck: No device frame, bezel, drawn phone, ghost echo or blurred type: the crop is the interface itself, marked data-ui, and the only framed window on the page; no labels floating around it; type inside it 14px or more; one accent.

name: Video with stacked chapter words
description: A full-screen looping video whose calm parts carry the text (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under each block only). At the top left on the page margin: the headline at the display step in two lines. In the lower right, right-aligned and ending on the right page margin: five one-word chapter links stacked at the sub step on a tight pitch (about 1.1 times the type size), lettered in whichever of ground and ink is lighter. Hovering or focusing a word dims the others to 40% opacity and swaps the video to that chapter's clip; clicking scrolls to the chapter. At the bottom left the dealt button and a short Pause link at the body step. The dealt navigation sits as dealt. The first frame is complete and it arrives with the dealt entrance.
signature: Five one-word chapter links stacked right-aligned at the lower right over a full-bleed looping video: hovering a word dims the others to 40% and swaps the video to that chapter's clip.
phone: The words at the lead step on a 1.2 pitch, right-aligned at the bottom, the headline at the top, the dealt button above the words.
houseRuleCheck: No label above the list; the words are chapter links, never numbered and never a second copy of the dealt navigation; all type is the page's own faces; no blend-mode tricks, plain lettering on the footage's calm parts.

name: Video with text in grid zones
description: A full-bleed looping video with calm parts where the text sits (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under each block only, no gradient). All text sits on a 3-column grid on the page margins in two rows. Middle row (vertically centred): the headline at the display step in two lines at the left across columns 1 and 2, and a two-line caption at the body step in column 3 on the same band. Bottom row: the dealt button at the left in column 1 and the dealt second action as a text link in column 3. There is no top row: the dealt navigation sits as dealt. The video is already playing in the first frame; it arrives with the dealt entrance. Lettering in whichever of ground and ink is lighter, the accent only on the dealt button.
signature: A full-bleed looping video with the headline in the left two of three columns and a two-line caption in the third on one band, and the button and a text link as the bottom row, with no boxes or bars.
phone: The columns collapse to one: the headline in the middle, the caption and the dealt button at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Small text at the body step in sentence case; no boxes or rules; no sound toggle unless the video has sound; one button, the dealt one; the top of the screen holds nothing but the dealt navigation.
